info.title: Calendly
info.description: Calendly is a scheduling automation platform. This connector enables querying events, invitees, availability, creating single-use booking links, and canceling events to complement the certified connector.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile including their URI, organization, and scheduling URL.
Lists scheduled events for a user with optional filtering by status, date range, and invitee email.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (e.g., https://api.calendly.com/users/ABCDEF123).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by event status.

parameters.name: min_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting at or after this time (ISO 8601, e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: max_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting before this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: invitee_email
parameters.description: Filter events by invitee email address.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: start_time:asc or start_time:desc.

200.description: A paginated list of scheduled events.

get.description: Returns the full details of a specific scheduled event by its UUID.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event (last segment of the event URI).

get.description: Lists all invitees for a specific scheduled event, including contact info and custom question responses.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by invitee status.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter by invitee email address.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: created_at:asc or created_at:desc.

200.description: A paginated list of event invitees.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled event with an optional cancellation reason sent to all participants.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event to cancel.

reason.description: Cancellation reason sent to all participants.

post.description: Creates a single-use scheduling link for an event type, ideal for personalized outreach.

owner.description: Event type URI to create the link for (from List Event Types).

max_event_count.description: Maximum number of bookings allowed (typically 1 for single-use).

get.description: Returns available time slots for a specific event type within a date range.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Event type URI (from List Event Types).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the availability window (ISO 8601, e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the availability window (ISO 8601).

200.description: A list of available time slots.

get.description: Lists all event types (meeting templates) for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (e.g., https://api.calendly.com/users/ABCDEF123).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter to only active (true) or inactive (false) event types.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: name:asc or name:desc.

200.description: A paginated list of event types.

get.description: Returns time ranges where the user is busy within a specified window.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the time range to check (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the time range to check (ISO 8601).

200.description: A list of busy time ranges.

get.description: Returns full details of a specific invitee for a scheduled event.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

parameters.name: invitee_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the invitee.

get.description: Returns the user configured availability schedules including working hours and time-off rules.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User.

slug.description: Calendly URL slug for the user.

avatar_url.description: URL of the user avatar image.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last profile update.

GetCurrentUserResponse.description: Response containing the authenticated user profile.

uri.description: Unique URI of the scheduled event.

name.description: Name of the event type (e.g., 30 Minute Meeting).

start_time.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format.

event_type.description: URI of the associated event type.

join_url.description: Video conference join URL, if applicable.

invitees_counter.description: Summary of invitee counts for this event.

limit.description: Maximum invitees allowed for this event.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was last updated.

event_memberships.description: List of host users for this event.

items.description: Host user membership for this event.

ListScheduledEventsResponse.description: Response containing a paginated list of scheduled events.

count.description: Number of results returned in this page.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. Null if no more pages.

GetScheduledEventResponse.description: Response containing a single scheduled event with full details.

uri.description: Unique URI of the scheduled event.

start_time.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format.

event_type.description: URI of the associated event type.

join_url.description: Video conference join URL, if applicable.

invitees_counter.description: Summary of invitee counts for this event.

limit.description: Maximum invitees allowed for this event.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was last updated.

event_memberships.description: List of host users for this event.

items.description: Host user membership for this event.

event_guests.description: Additional guest emails for this event.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the guest was added.

Invitee.description: An invitee for a scheduled event.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the invitee booked.

questions_and_answers.description: Custom question responses from the invitee.

items.description: Custom question and answer from the invitee.

rescheduled.description: Whether this invitee was rescheduled from another event.

no_show.description: No-show record if marked, null otherwise.

payment.description: Payment details if applicable, null otherwise.

ListInviteesResponse.description: Response containing a paginated list of invitees.

count.description: Number of results returned in this page.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. Null if no more pages.

GetInviteeResponse.description: Response containing a single invitee with full details.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the invitee booked.

questions_and_answers.description: Custom question responses from the invitee.

items.description: Custom question and answer from the invitee.

old_invitee.description: URI of previous invitee record if rescheduled.

new_invitee.description: URI of new invitee record if rescheduled.

no_show.description: No-show record if marked, null otherwise.

payment.description: Payment details if applicable, null otherwise.

CancelEventResponse.description: Response after canceling a scheduled event.

canceled_by.description: Name of the person who canceled.

CreateSchedulingLinkResponse.description: Response after creating a scheduling link.

booking_url.description: The single-use scheduling URL to share.

owner.description: The event type URI this link belongs to.

AvailableTime.description: An available time slot for booking.

status.description: Slot availability status: available or unavailable.

invitees_remaining.description: Number of spots remaining for group events.

start_time.description: Slot start time in ISO 8601 format.

scheduling_url.description: Direct booking URL for this time slot.

collection.description: Array of available time slot objects.

uri.description: Unique URI of the event type.

active.description: Whether this event type is currently active.

description_plain.description: Plain text description of the event type.

internal_note.description: Internal note not visible to invitees.

secret.description: Whether hidden from the public booking page.

ListEventTypesResponse.description: Response containing a paginated list of event types.

count.description: Number of results returned in this page.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. Null if no more pages.

BusyTime.description: A time range where the user is busy.

type.description: Type of busy time (e.g., calendly, external).

start_time.description: Busy period start in ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: Busy period end in ISO 8601 format.

buffered.description: Whether this includes buffer time around an event.

event.description: Reference to the Calendly event causing the busy time.

collection.description: Array of busy time range objects.

AvailabilityRule.description: An availability rule within a schedule.

type.description: Rule type: wday (weekday) or date (specific date).

wday.description: Day of week (e.g., monday). Only for wday type rules.

date.description: Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only for date type rules.

uri.description: Unique URI of the availability schedule.

default.description: Whether this is the default schedule.
